we present a new random access scheme for wireless networks that satisfies the QoS requirements of two classes of users, we prove that our algorithm achieves stability for a large class arrival processes and we show through analysis that our algorithm asymptoticaly achieves the optimal network utilization.
we present an access protocol that achieves high network utilization for multimedia traffic with QoS guarantees.
we propose an access scheme that satisfies QoS requirements for multiple classes of traffic in a wireless network, and show that it has high network utilization.

the design and analysis of a new class-based random access protocol for packet-switched wireless multimedia networks.
developing a new access scheme that provides QoS guarantees for two classes of multimedia traffic during the contention phases of wireless packet-switched communications.
the development of a new class of random access schemes for multimedia wireless networks.

the proposed algorithm is a good choice for multimedia traffic in wireless packet-switched networks.

our scheme provides a simple, yet efficient, way of achieving high network utilization for multimedia wireless networks.

we have developed an algorithm that is simple to implement and achieves high throughput.
our proposed algorithm is simple and efficient in terms of network throughput.

The main takeaway from our work is that
, by controlling the permission probability of different traffic classes in random access networks, one can achieve high network utilization while guaranteeing QoS for different classes of traffic.
, with a simple modification of the permission probability, one can achieve high network utilization while satisfying QoS requirements for a large class traffic types.
, by controlling the contention probabilities of different classes of users, it is possible to achieve high network utilization while guaranteeing the required QoS requirements for each class.
